m55.notes: platform_tester.bin (BEST1600 M55 app). Raw indexOf: en_usb\0 at 0x1605e8, enable usb\0 at 0x1605f0 (fac_cmd name/help pair, packed with neighboring cmds). First DRVUSB at 0x1468c4 (duplicate at 0x14c220); both sit in a BES TRACE-module table between DRVSEC and AUDFLG. First vbus usb_enable at 0x42afe inside sc7288_charger.c log '[CHG] vbus usb_enable:%d disable_reason:0x%x' (full C-string at 0x42af8). Absent as ASCII and UTF-16LE/BE: analog_usb, usbphy, usb_phy, CDC_ACM, dwc2, dwc, UsbDevice, gadget, TinyUSB, usb_open, hal_cmu_usb, USB_DP, USB_DN, CHIP_HAS_USB, usb_serial, hal_usb. 11 tusb hits are launcher_statusbar_* (first 0x16c51c), not TinyUSB. VID 0xBE57/0x2b0e/0x0a12 do not appear as ASCII or UTF-16; no USB device descriptor (bLength=18, bDescriptorType=1) carries those VIDs. Remaining usb bytes are charger/VBUS/power_supply telemetry, not a gadget stack.

bth.notes: best1600_watch_bth.bin (BTH). Sole USB-token C-string is TRACE tag DRVUSB at 0xe6630 in the same DRVANA/DRVCODEC/DRVBT/DRVFLS/DRVSEC/DRVUSB/AUDFLG module table as M55. No en_usb, enable usb, vbus, Vbus, hal_usb, analog_usb, usbphy, usb_phy, CDC_ACM, dwc2, UsbDevice, gadget, TinyUSB, tusb, usb_open, hal_cmu_usb, USB_DP, USB_DN, CHIP_HAS_USB, usb_serial. PMU strings 'Charger plug out.' at 0x1326e0 and 'Charger plug in.' at 0x1326fc are charger events, not USB protocol. No ASCII/UTF-16 VID 0xBE57/0x2b0e/0x0a12 and no matching device descriptor.

conclusion: Wired Type-C D+/D− cannot enumerate from these 1.0.12.83 images: M55 6771708 B and BTH 1341116 B have no gadget/PHY driver (no hal_usb, analog_usb, usbphy, usb_phy, CDC_ACM, dwc2, UsbDevice, gadget, TinyUSB, usb_open, hal_cmu_usb, USB_DP, USB_DN, CHIP_HAS_USB, usb_serial; tusb hits are launcher_statusbar). Residue is SC7288 charger VBUS telemetry, power_supply USB temperature, TRACE tag DRVUSB, and fac_cmd en_usb/enable usb. That factory name cannot bring up a USB protocol stack that was never linked, so this firmware will not CDC/MSC/HID-enumerate even with D+/D− connected.
